articles.summary: Today, DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. (NYSE: DKS) announced a multi-year partnership with basketball star, Caitlin Clark , uniting one of the most influential athletes with one of the leading sports retailers to bring Clark's brand to fans across the world. The exclusive deal includes DICK'S and Foot Locker, marking the first time either company has signed an athlete as a brand partner. "DICK'S Sporting Goods was always a stop before the start of any sports season when I was growing up," said Clark. "Being the first ever brand partner for both them and Foot Locker is a really special full-circle moment. Both brands have deep roots in sport, basketball and sneaker culture, and have strong connections with fans in the U.S. and around the world." articles.title: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. Signs Caitlin Clark as First-Ever Brand Partner Across DICK'S and Foot Locker

articles.summary: Golf Galaxy is teeing off Black Friday with a new way for golfers to win big. Today, the retailer announced its first-ever "Pick a Tag. Win Some Swag." giveaway, taking place at all Golf Galaxy stores nationwide on November 27. Starting at store open, 7 a.m. local time, golfers who visit their local Golf Galaxy can randomly select an envelope to reveal an instant prize, with the first 30 participants guaranteed to win. Prizes range from golf balls, tees and gloves to gift cards, complimentary in-store services and more. One athlete at every Golf Galaxy location will also score the local grand prize: an exclusive swag bag valued over $500 packed with products from top golf brands and a unique Golf Galaxy in-store experience. In addition, one nationwide grand prize winner will receive the ultimate at-home golf setup, featuring a Garmin R50 Launch Monitor, a full TaylorMade bag set and a head-to-toe FootJoy wardrobe. articles.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods (NYSE: DKS) today introduced its first-ever officially licensed collegiate collections from exclusive brands VRST, CALIA and DSG, marking an exciting expansion of the vertical brands business into collegiate apparel. With fresh takes on fan apparel, The Ohio State University and University of Iowa collections give Buckeye and Hawkeye fans new ways to show their pride and represent the teams they love, whether it's game day or any day. "Growing our vertical brands means continuing to find new ways to meet athletes where they are and deliver the styles they're looking for," said Aimee Watters, VP of Vertical Brands at DICK'S. "Partnerships play an important role in that strategy, helping us reach new athletes and bring our brands into new spaces, and fan apparel is a natural next step in that growth." The collections include t-shirts, pants and layering pieces for men's, women's and youth, and will be available at select DICK'S and DICK'S House of Sport locations
articles.title: DICK'S Launches First-Ever Collegiate Licensed Collections from Exclusive Brands VRST, CALIA and DSG
